card.name: Words just before problem or issue
card.fires_on: Small words and modifiers right before an expected 'problem(s)' or 'issue(s)', such as 'our' or 'economic' in 'blamed for our problems', or 'be' in 'can be solved'. It appears in general web text about causes and solutions.

modes.label: Modifier before problems
modes.description: A possessive or adjective that leads straight into the noun 'problems'.
modes.example: blaming government for most of<< our>> problems

modes.label: Solving a problem
modes.description: A helper word such as 'be' or 'to' where the text goes on to solve or deduce something, after a problem was mentioned.
modes.example: This problem can<< be>> solved by using a lens with a long

modes.label: Problem itself
modes.description: The word 'problem' in a phrase about what an invention or method addresses.
modes.example: The background can also state the<< problem>> that the invention solves.

card.writes: It promotes 'issue' and 'issues' words and suppresses 'pro' forms, so it pushes the next word toward issue/problem wording.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a problem or issue, or talk about solving one.
